rationale: The smaller-network-step pure model has lower standalone donor ES but worse cell ED. Test one fixed75/25 pure mixture with learned-observation forecasts for complementarity, as a source-only follow-up hypothesis. Do not scan weights or masks, and do not alter the currently frozen PG8+learned three-seed confirmation.
decision: Analytic expectation over uniform fixed50-of200 masks and weighted empirical cell reservoirs only. Promising screen requires lower ES and no greater cell ED than CURRENT selected pure incumbent, not merely baseline. Native mask/RNG/count/spread/complete-source proof and fresh fixed-seed confirmation would still be required before any selection. A failed screen is not a completed native model result.
allowed_inputs: Existing generated seed0 arrays and already-verified scalar metrics/checkpoint proofs only. No new target/evaluation donor arrays, fitting, generation, GPU allocation or modelsource edits.
